summary: Frontend-only regression test for the /technician grouping bug fix and the Settings 'Reglas de Hoja de Ruta' role dropdown. Result: The Settings dropdown fix WORKS (9 options including Corte + Instalación). The Technician grouping fix DOES NOT WORK — the BUGTST slot (role='polarizado', label='Corte', assigned to Carlos) still appears under the Instalación tab (badge=2) instead of the Corte tab. The Corte tab is empty and shows 'Sin servicios asignados en Corte'. The global alert correctly counts 2 pendientes.

ui_bugs.issue: BUG NOT FIXED. Slot with role='polarizado' and custom label='Corte' is still routed to the Instalación section, not Corte. Root cause: in /app/frontend/src/pages/TechnicianView.jsx (L32-41) the function slotSectionId matches by `role` FIRST and only falls back to `labelKeywords` if no role match is found. Since 'polarizado' is included in the Instalación section's roles list, the label fallback never executes. Result: Carlos sees Corte tab empty and Instalación tab with badge=2 (both slots grouped there).

action_items: Fix slotSectionId in /app/frontend/src/pages/TechnicianView.jsx: when the slot has a custom label whose keyword matches a specific section (e.g. 'Corte'), that label match must take PRIORITY over the generic role match. Suggested implementation: (a) match label keywords FIRST, then fall back to role; OR (b) treat the label as authoritative when it hits a labelKeyword of a different section than the role would map to; OR (c) add 'polarizado' out of the Instalación.roles list only when the label clearly indicates another section. Recommended: try labelKeywords first, then role fallback.

After the fix, retest: login as tecnico1@polarizadosya.com and verify BUGTST appears in the Corte tab with 'Finalizar y enviar reporte' button, alert-corte badge shows 1, and the finish dialog flow completes (notes + photo → toast success → card removed from Corte).
critical_code_review_comments: slotSectionId priority is backwards for the intended behavior. Comment on L35 says 'Match por role explícito (más fuerte)' but the bug is exactly that role dominates over the more-specific label the user chose.

SECTIONS array duplicates role membership loosely (e.g. 'instalacion' section owns 'polarizado','ppf','ultrasecure') which makes label-based disambiguation essential; the current implementation never reaches it for those roles.
seed_data_creation: None. BUGTST order was pre-seeded by main agent. Verified visible in Carlos dashboard (Bug Test / BUGTST).
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent flips slotSectionId to try label keywords BEFORE role (or applies equivalent logic), re-run technician flow: expect alert-corte=1, panel-corte contains BUGTST card with finish-slot-* button, opening dialog shows label 'Corte', finishing with notes+photo removes card from Corte panel. Settings dropdown fix already verified (9 role options).
rca of the issue: slotSectionId in TechnicianView.jsx checks SECTIONS.find(s => s.roles.includes(role)) FIRST. Since the slot's role is 'polarizado', it matches the Instalación section (which lists 'polarizado' among its roles) and returns immediately, ignoring the custom label 'Corte'. The intended fix (label-based disambiguation for custom labels) requires label matching to run first when a label is present, or at least when the role's own section keyword is not present in the label (e.g. role='polarizado' but label doesn't contain 'polariz' → prefer label mapping).
